messages:
lily (AE): quick question — customer asking for worst-case GPU credit / reserved capacity numbers for their enterprise commit POC. they want to know preheat, burst pool, and autoscale safety margins so finance can price it. any quick ballpark we can give?

mike (Solutions Eng): need workload profile first. what rps and avg tokens per request? also percent of peak that needs sub-200ms p50 latency?

lily (AE): their app: chat assistant. baseline 20 rps, peaks ~250 rps for 10min bursts. avg prompt+response ~600 tokens. target p50 <250ms for 95% of requests during peak.

mike (Solutions Eng): ok. rough calc: tokens/sec during peak ~250 * 600 = 150k tokens/sec. with our medium-quantized model throughput ~30k tokens/sec per GPU -> ~5 GPUs sustained. but latency SLO means smaller batch sizes -> expect ~6-7 GPUs to keep p50 low.

sam (Infra): +1 to mike. recommend reserved pool = 6 GPUs for guaranteed runway. add burst/credit pool = 2-3 GPUs for short 10min spikes. autoscale policy: keep min_replicas=6, max_replicas=9, scale_out_threshold=70%, cooldown=90s. prewarm window = 60s before expected window.

priya (SRE): security/ops note: if they require VPC/private deployment we can't share burst across regions easily — burst capacity must be provisioned in their VPC or as dedicated reserved. that changes pricing. also KMS for keys + audit logs will add seat/license delta.

mike (Solutions Eng): pricing delta rough: reserved 6 GPUs month -> x, 2-3 burst GPUs as optional monthly or metered credits. if they want metered burst credits, expect ~20-30% premium vs pure reserved (covers capacity runway). i can run exact numbers with customer account size.

lily (AE): perfect. can you put those numbers in a short blurb I can send to finance? also need a brief runbook snippet for on-call if autoscale fails.

mike (Solutions Eng): sending blurb now. snippet: 
```
policy:
  min_replicas: 6
  max_replicas: 9
  scale_metric: cpu_or_tokens
  scale_out_threshold: 0.7
  scale_in_threshold: 0.4
  scale_out_cooldown_s: 90
  prewarm_seconds: 60
fallback:
  - route_to_lower-cost-model if latency>500ms for >30s
  - enable-cache-prefetch
```

sam (Infra): runbook bullet points: monitor queue length + token/sec. if autoscale fails to add nodes within 120s, trigger manual failover to lower-cost model and open incident with infra oncall. add capacity-adjustment playbook attached to the POC workspace.

priya (SRE): security asks to add to questionnaire: data residency (EU? ), KMS provider, access controls for keys, and retention period for logs. these affect whether we recommend Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private.

lily (AE): thanks all. action items: mike -> formal pricing delta and short blurb for finance; sam -> add runbook to POC workspace; priya -> list security items to include in the questionnaire; i'll send to customer and ask for preferred preheat windows.

ops-bot: deployment note: POC workspace provisioned (id: ws-9a7f). resources not yet allocated until commit signed.

lily (AE): noted. will update. :thumbsup:
